proofs.text:
The actual product-density identity gives 

  ρAGC(w)=|Ω⊗m⟩⟨Ω⊗m|⊗ρC(w).

 A permutation only reorders the identical factors of Ω⊗m. Thus PmΩ⊗m=Ω⊗m. Multiplying the product density by Pm⊗IC proves the assertion.
